statements.impact_statement: libcurl could reuse a connection set up with Negotiate (SPNEGO) authentication and blank credentials for a later request from a different user. Blank Negotiate credentials mean an ambient user whose credentials are held by the GSS-API library or Windows SSPI; see https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-19931.html (affected 7.64.1 to 8.21.0, fixed in 8.22.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/7103a93b05bc69ea98ed9d05d02fa9eeba533f2f). libcurl compiles its Negotiate support only when built with a GSS-API library, or SSPI on Windows. The DHI Alpine 3.23 curl packages are built from the Alpine aports curl recipe, which configures curl without GSS-API and has no Kerberos library among its dependencies. Inspected every published build on x86_64 and aarch64 (8.17.0-r1 to 8.23.0-r1): libcurl.so needs no GSS-API or Kerberos library; in libcurl.a the http_negotiate, spnego_gssapi and krb5_gssapi objects define no symbols, while the digest authentication object defines its functions; and the debug symbols for libcurl.so contain no Negotiate functions (Curl_input_negotiate, Curl_output_negotiate, Curl_auth_create_spnego_message), while other authentication functions such as Curl_auth_create_digest_http_message are present. The Negotiate connection-reuse code this CVE concerns is not compiled into these packages.
